name: MAC cannon
blurb: Few, heavy shots from long range. Bites through armour, weak against shields.

name: Archer missile pod
blurb: A salvo of six missiles at medium range. Good against shields. Point defence can shoot them down.

name: Autocannon battery
blurb: A hail of rounds at point-blank range. Thick armour shrugs it off.

name: Point defence
blurb: Flak and chain guns that stop incoming missiles, on this ship and (less well) its neighbours.

name: Ablative plating
blurb: Adds 40% armour. Shrugs off small hits.

name: Targeting uplink
blurb: Shares sensor data across the group: +10% damage from this ship.
